title: Professional Certificate Course in Framework For Global Supply Chain Ecosystem
description: Gain expertise in managing and optimizing global supply chain networks
longDescription: Our Professional Certificate Course in Framework for Global Supply Chain Ecosystem is designed to provide participants with a comprehensive understanding of supply chain management. The course covers the nature and elements of supply chain delivery infrastructure, including mapping the ecosystem of both supply and service chains, such as the auto vertical and inbound logistics. Additionally, the course introduces the concept of GRIP analysis and its key elements, which are essential for managing and optimizing global supply chains. Through this course, participants will gain the skills and knowledge needed to develop effective strategies, mitigate risks, optimize logistics, and collaborate within the complex ecosystem of global supply chains.
